labels_source: official PyG ZINC subset train only

features.low_order_layout: n_atoms, 21 atom-type counts, 3 bond-type counts, n_rings, n_ring_atoms, n_aromatic_atoms (all signed i-j)

gate.note: The pre-registered gate class is the radius-1 typed signature at the attachment point.  The full-substituent class is reported separately and has no cross-body repetition; the signal is therefore a composition-additive transfer signal, not a full-substituent identity signal.
